text: The Board confirms that each of these nominees is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. Please note that the term of the following member has now come to an end: - Ellen Fisher resigned effective February 26, 2025. - Violeta Rangel resigned effective February 26, 2026. On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint these nominated and re-elected candidates.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Nominated the following individuals for appointment to the Central Eglinton Community Centre Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending April 26, 2028, and until successors are appointed: - David Tadeusz Chudak - Lindsey Tully 2. Re-appointed the following individuals to the Central Eglinton Community Centre Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending April 26, 2028, and until successors are appointed: - Nancy Haddad-Albina - Harriet Velazquez - Celine Devlin - James Sutcliffe - Federico Cervantes
